items.text: A career development plan at work becomes persuasive when each of your growth goals is tied to a business goal your manager already cares about, so that learning, projects and promotion asks all point at results the team needs.
Write a one-page plan with three business goals, the skills they need, the evidence you will collect and the dates you will review.
Ask HR or your manager for the current policy.
